abstract:
BACKGROUND: Pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (PNETs) are rare neoplasms of the digestive system, with variable prognoses and biological behaviors. Surgical resection remains the mainstay of treatment. Objective: To evaluate the clinicopathological characteristics and surgical outcomes of patients with PNETs who underwent resection at the Hospital de Clínicas, UNICAMP.
METHODS: This is a retrospective cohort study including 24 patients who underwent surgical resection between 2013 and 2023. Clinical, demographic, histopathological, and survival data were analyzed. The primary outcome was overall survival.
RESULTS: The mean age was 53.9 ± 14.4 years, with a predominance of female patients (66.7%). Most tumors were nonfunctioning (79.1%), with abdominal pain (79.2%) and weight loss (50%) being the most common symptoms. The surgical procedures performed were distal pancreatectomy (54.2%), pancreaticoduodenectomy (41.6%), and enucleation (4.2%). Histological classification revealed 62.5% grade 2 tumors, 33.3% grade 1, and 4.2% MiNEN. Mean overall survival was 70.4 ± 58 months. There was a trend toward longer survival in grade 1 tumors (98 ± 68.1 months) compared to grade 2 (59.1 ± 49.5 months; P=0.06). Postoperative mortality was 8.3%, associated with pancreaticoduodenectomy.
CONCLUSION: Histological grading remains a key prognostic factor in PNETs. Surgical resection remains the cornerstone of treatment. Multicenter studies are necessary to validate these findings on a larger scale.

1등급 종양의 평균 생존기간은 98 ± 68.1개월, 2등급은 59.1 ± 49.5개월로 1등급에서 더 긴 생존 경향을 보였습니다(P=0.06).
수술 후 사망률은 8.3%였으며 췌십이지장절제술(pancreaticoduodenectomy)과 관련이 있었습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 2013년부터 2023년까지 췌장 신경내분비종양(PNET)으로 수술적 절제를 받은 환자 24명을 대상으로 한 후향적 코호트 연구입니다. 환자들의 임상병리학적 특징과 수술 후 결과를 분석했습니다. 연구 결과, 평균 전체 생존기간(overall survival)은 70.4 ± 58개월이었으며, 1등급 종양이 2등급에 비해 더 긴 생존 경향을 보였습니다. 수술 후 사망률은 8.3%였으며 췌십이지장절제술(pancreaticoduodenectomy)과 연관되었습니다. 저자들은 조직학적 등급이 PNET의 핵심 예후 인자라고 결론지었습니다.
title: PANCREATIC NEUROENDOCRINE TUMORS: CLINICOPATHOLOGICAL ANALYSIS AND POSTOPERATIVE SURVIVAL FOLLOWING SURGICAL RESECTION-A DECADE OF EXPERIENCE AT A TERTIARY UNIVERSITY HOSPITAL
title_ko: 췌장 신경내분비종양: 수술적 절제 후 임상병리학적 분석 및 수술 후 생존율 - 3차 대학병원에서의 10년간 경험
